title: A lane writing scratch output outside its worktree is refused
body:
On 2026-11-17 the t-8e4kdzz lane wrote its ship output to /tmp/x, outside its worktree, although its brief carries the scratch rule (.krn/tmp inside the worktree). Nothing refused it; the lane reported it itself.
Outcome: a lane session's Bash command that redirects output to a path outside its worktree and outside the session scratchpad is refused (or flagged at Stop) with the scratch rule named.
Proof: a hook test with a lane command 'cmd > /tmp/x' is refused; the same command writing .krn/tmp/x passes.
